## Definition of done

- [ ] Typed contract and outcome taxonomy for anything new
- [ ] Domain invariants and authorisation covered
- [ ] Idempotency and retry semantics considered
- [ ] Provenance or audit events emitted where a decision is made
- [ ] Unit, contract, and integration tests
- [ ] User and operator documentation updated
- [ ] Migration and backward compatibility notes, if the schema moved
- [ ] Rights and threat review, if this moves data anywhere new
- [ ] No unexplained config or generated-schema drift
